name: ANSI/IEEE Combined loudspeaker and microphone form
summary: IEEE-library form of combined loudspeaker and microphone: this representation identifies an electroacoustic device serving loudspeaker and microphone roles.
description: This reference locates combined loudspeaker and microphone in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented annunciations family. This representation identifies an electroacoustic device serving loudspeaker and microphone roles. The public library uses HAN1B8 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
